Wait a second, Qing... which packet of butter did you grab?

Oh no! I was running in such a rush that the wrappers all looked alike!
Can salted butter go with sweet strawberry jam?
Wait—salted butter fails with jam, yet for scrambled eggs it is amazing!
Phew, quick thinking saves breakfast once again!

examples.text: 门上方只画着一把金色钥匙。拿旧阀门给店员看。
examples.trans: Only a golden key painted above the door. Show the clerk the old valve.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bāo zhuāng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个包装 ('a wrapper / package').

examples.text: 最上面架子上金色包装那包。怎么了？
examples.trans: The gold-wrapped packet on the top shelf. Why?

examples.text: 哎呀！我跑得太急，包装看着都一样！
examples.trans: Oh no! I was running in such a rush that the wrappers all looked alike!

meanings.note: Pinyin: nà. Distal demonstrative before measure words (那个 'that one'); at clause start, means 'then / well then'.

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zěn me. Before a verb, asks 'how to do X?' (怎么走) or 'how come…?' (怎么还没来).

examples.text: 我的眼镜怎么会在……哎呀！在我头上！
examples.trans: Why would my glasses be in... oh dear! They are on my head!

examples.text: 宋老师，怎么了？您按了门铃！
examples.trans: Teacher Song, what happened? You rang the bell!

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎi yán. Measure word (量词): 撮, e.g. 一撮海盐 ('a pinch of sea salt').

examples.text: 那是海盐咸黄油！甜果酱面包卷要无盐黄油！
examples.trans: That is sea-salt butter! Sweet jam rolls need unsalted butter!

examples.text: 小晴买了海盐黄油，今天我们做嫩炒蛋！
examples.trans: Qing bought sea-salt butter, so today we are making soft scrambled eggs!

related.gloss: a pinch of sea salt (measure word 撮)

meanings.note: Pinyin: xián. Describes salted butter or savory dishes.

examples.text: 那是海盐咸黄油！甜果酱面包卷要无盐黄油！
examples.trans: That is sea-salt butter! Sweet jam rolls need unsalted butter!

examples.text: 咸黄油能配甜草莓果酱吗？
examples.trans: Can salted butter go with sweet strawberry jam?

meanings.note: Pinyin: tián. Describes sweet pastries, fruit, or tea with honey.

examples.text: 那是海盐咸黄油！甜果酱面包卷要无盐黄油！
examples.trans: That is sea-salt butter! Sweet jam rolls need unsalted butter!

examples.text: 咸黄油能配甜草莓果酱吗？
examples.trans: Can salted butter go with sweet strawberry jam?

meanings.note: Pinyin: guǒ jiàng. Measure word (量词): 瓶 (píng), e.g. 一瓶果酱 ('a jar of jam').

examples.text: 那是海盐咸黄油！甜果酱面包卷要无盐黄油！
examples.trans: That is sea-salt butter! Sweet jam rolls need unsalted butter!

examples.text: 咸黄油能配甜草莓果酱吗？
examples.trans: Can salted butter go with sweet strawberry jam?

related.gloss: a jar of jam (measure word 瓶)

meanings.note: Pinyin: miàn bāo juǎn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个面包卷 ('a bread roll').

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

examples.text: 那是海盐咸黄油！甜果酱面包卷要无盐黄油！
examples.trans: That is sea-salt butter! Sweet jam rolls need unsalted butter!

meanings.en: want; need; will / be going to
meanings.note: Pinyin: yào. Direct verb for ordering/requesting ('want'), obligation ('need to'), or imminent future (要下雨了).

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

meanings.note: Pinyin: wú yán. Baking label meaning 'salt-free' (无盐黄油 'unsalted butter').

examples.text: 那是海盐咸黄油！甜果酱面包卷要无盐黄油！
examples.trans: That is sea-salt butter! Sweet jam rolls need unsalted butter!

examples.text: 烤柠檬蛋糕需要用新鲜的无盐黄油。
examples.trans: Baking lemon cake calls for fresh unsalted butter.

meanings.note: Pinyin: āi yā. Expresses mild dismay or sudden surprise.

examples.text: 我的眼镜怎么会在……哎呀！在我头上！
examples.trans: Why would my glasses be in... oh dear! They are on my head!

examples.text: 我来帮您。哎呀，里面装了石头吗？
examples.trans: Let me help you. Goodness, did you pack stones inside?

meanings.note: Pinyin: pǎo. Everyday verb for running.

examples.text: 那个人为什么不拿回自己的箱子就跑了？
examples.trans: Why did that person run off without taking his own suitcase back?

examples.text: 十分钟之内你能跑个来回吗？
examples.trans: Can you run there and back within ten minutes?

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Read de after a verb to introduce how it goes (走得快 'walk fast'); read děi before a verb to mean 'must'.

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tài. Often frames 太 + adj + 了 for warm exclamations (太好了！ 'Wonderful!').

examples.text: 太好了。请告诉我需要知道什么。
examples.trans: Great. Please tell me what I need to know.

examples.text: 太好了。窗户朝街上还是朝院子？
examples.trans: Wonderful. Does the window face the street or the courtyard?

meanings.note: Pinyin: jí. Describes rushing or feeling anxious.

examples.text: 哎呀！我跑得太急，包装看着都一样！
examples.trans: Oh no! I was running in such a rush that the wrappers all looked alike!

examples.text: 快坐在向阳窗户边，宋老师！先别急着上楼！
examples.trans: Sit right down by the sunny window, Teacher Song! No rush to go back upstairs yet!

meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn. Covers looking at something, reading silently, or visiting someone; add 见/到 for 'catch sight of'.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhe. Placed right after a verb to show a state or posture continues (门开着 'the door stands open').

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yí yàng. Pairs with 跟/和 in 跟…一样 ('the same as…').

examples.text: 等等，深蓝色的，跟您的一样啊！
examples.trans: Wait—it is dark blue, the same as yours!

examples.text: 哎呀！我跑得太急，包装看着都一样！
examples.trans: Oh no! I was running in such a rush that the wrappers all looked alike!

meanings.note: Pinyin: néng. Expresses practical ability or whether circumstances allow something (能睡个好觉).

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

examples.text: 今晚我应该能睡个好觉了。
examples.trans: Tonight I should be able to sleep well after all.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pèi. Used for pairing foods together or cutting spare keys.

examples.text: 咸黄油能配甜草莓果酱吗？
examples.trans: Can salted butter go with sweet strawberry jam?

examples.text: 等等，咸黄油配果酱不行，做炒蛋却棒极了！
examples.trans: Wait—salted butter fails with jam, yet for scrambled eggs it is amazing!

meanings.note: Pinyin: cǎo méi. Measure word (量词): 颗 (kē), e.g. 一颗草莓 ('a strawberry').

examples.text: 咸黄油能配甜草莓果酱吗？
examples.trans: Can salted butter go with sweet strawberry jam?

examples.text: 桌上的小玻璃瓶里装着自制草莓果酱。
examples.trans: Homemade strawberry jam fills the small glass jar on the table.

meanings.note: Pinyin: děng deng. Urgent or casual reduplication of 等 ('wait!').

examples.text: 等等，深蓝色的，跟您的一样啊！
examples.trans: Wait—it is dark blue, the same as yours!

examples.text: 等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xíng. Read xíng when meaning 'that works / okay' (不行 'won't work'); read háng when counting lines of text (第一行).

examples.text: 等等，咸黄油配果酱不行，做炒蛋却棒极了！
examples.trans: Wait—salted butter fails with jam, yet for scrambled eggs it is amazing!

examples.text: 小晴，替我念第一行。快说是我眼镜又看花眼了！
examples.trans: Qing, read the top line for me. Tell me my glasses are playing tricks on my eyes!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuò. Everyday verb for preparing food, doing work, or making objects.

examples.text: 等等，咸黄油配果酱不行，做炒蛋却棒极了！
examples.trans: Wait—salted butter fails with jam, yet for scrambled eggs it is amazing!

examples.text: 小晴买了海盐黄油，今天我们做嫩炒蛋！
examples.trans: Qing bought sea-salt butter, so today we are making soft scrambled eggs!

meanings.note: Pinyin: chǎo dàn. Measure word (量词): 盘, e.g. 一盘炒蛋 ('a plate of scrambled eggs').

examples.text: 等等，咸黄油配果酱不行，做炒蛋却棒极了！
examples.trans: Wait—salted butter fails with jam, yet for scrambled eggs it is amazing!

examples.text: 小晴买了海盐黄油，今天我们做嫩炒蛋！
examples.trans: Qing bought sea-salt butter, so today we are making soft scrambled eggs!

related.gloss: a plate of scrambled eggs (measure word 盘)

meanings.note: Pinyin: què. Always sits AFTER the subject and BEFORE the verb to mark contrast ('yet, surprisingly').

examples.text: 等等，咸黄油配果酱不行，做炒蛋却棒极了！
examples.trans: Wait—salted butter fails with jam, yet for scrambled eggs it is amazing!

examples.text: 没错。外面大街很吵，进了院子却只听见树叶和小鸟。
examples.trans: Exactly. Outside on the main road it is noisy, yet inside the courtyard you only hear leaves and birds.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bàng. Warm colloquial adjective for praising food, work, or ideas (太棒了！).

examples.text: 等等，咸黄油配果酱不行，做炒蛋却棒极了！
examples.trans: Wait—salted butter fails with jam, yet for scrambled eggs it is amazing!

examples.text: 太棒了！用钢笔把你的名字正式写进老陈的大纸本子里！
examples.trans: Wonderful! Your name goes into Chen's big paper ledger in fountain-pen ink!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jí le. Follows directly after an adjective to boost it to the max (棒极了！ 'amazing!', 热极了 'super hot!').

examples.text: 等等，咸黄油配果酱不行，做炒蛋却棒极了！
examples.trans: Wait—salted butter fails with jam, yet for scrambled eggs it is amazing!

examples.text: 这是我这个月睡得最香的一晚，洗澡水也热极了！
examples.trans: Best sleep I have had all month, and the shower water was wonderfully hot!

meanings.note: Pinyin: hū. Imitates letting out a relieved breath.

examples.text: 呼，好在反应快，早餐又有救了！
examples.trans: Phew, quick thinking saves breakfast once again!

examples.text: 呼，终于赶上早班火车了。
examples.trans: Phew, we finally caught the morning train.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎo zài. Relieved adverb introducing a saving grace.

examples.text: 呼，好在反应快，早餐又有救了！
examples.trans: Phew, quick thinking saves breakfast once again!

examples.text: 好在我们备了两把新钥匙。
examples.trans: Thankfully we kept two spare keys ready.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fǎn yìng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个反应 ('a reaction').

examples.text: 呼，好在反应快，早餐又有救了！
examples.trans: Phew, quick thinking saves breakfast once again!

examples.text: 听到这个好消息，大家的反应都很开心。
examples.trans: Hearing the good news, everyone reacted with joy.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǎo cān. Measure word (量词): 顿 (dùn), e.g. 一顿早餐 ('a breakfast').

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

examples.text: 太好了！现在我想吃一顿丰盛的早餐。
examples.trans: Wonderful! Now I would like to eat a big breakfast.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòu. Marks an action repeating, or pairs two qualities in 又A又B ('both A and B').

examples.text: 真的可以吗？看着又好看又暖和！
examples.trans: Is that really alright? It looks both lovely and warm!

examples.text: 又是深蓝色行李箱！这是宋老师的吗？
examples.trans: Another dark-blue suitcase! Is this Teacher Song's?

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǒu. Expresses both possession ('I have') and existence ('there is'); ALWAYS negated with 没 (没有), never 不.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù. Used for saving a historic building or rescuing breakfast.

examples.text: 你们这些好人真是救了我这趟旅行。
examples.trans: You kind people have truly saved this whole trip of mine.

examples.text: 呼，好在反应快，早餐又有救了！
examples.trans: Phew, quick thinking saves breakfast once again!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià cì. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 下一次 ('the next occasion').

examples.text: 下次来成都，一定再来住我们客栈！
examples.trans: Next time you come to Chengdu, be sure to stay at our inn again!

examples.text: 今天聊得很开心，我们下次见！
examples.trans: It was lovely chatting today—see you next time!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiàn. Appears in farewells (再见, 明天见) and as result complement of perception (看见, 听见).

examples.text: 晚安，小晴。明天早餐见。
examples.trans: Good night, Qing. See you at breakfast tomorrow.

examples.text: 老陈，听得见吗？我刚经过绿药店！
examples.trans: Chen, can you hear me? I just passed the green pharmacy!
